Careers at Meridian

12,400 people in 14 countries design, build and maintain equipment that cities and industries depend on. We hire engineers, technicians, planners and graduates every year.

Graduate program

A two-year rotation through design, manufacturing and service, with placements in at least two countries.

Apprenticeships

Four-year trade apprenticeships at our Australian and New Zealand plants, with a guaranteed role on completion.
